item.title: The JavaScript Rat Race: Chasing the Next Big Framework
item.description:
As a developer who’s been in the trenches for years, I’ve seen my fair share of JavaScript frameworks come and go. It’s like we’re all stuck in some kind of twisted “JavaScript rat game,” always scrambling for the next shiny tool that promises to solve all our problems. But let’s be real for a second – does it ever actually work out that way?

The Never-Ending Cycle

Every damn day, it seems like there’s a new JavaScript framework or library popping up on GitHub or npm. “This one’s gonna revolutionize front-end development!” they say. “It’s 10x faster and easier to use!” they claim. And like the good little developer rats we are, we scurry towards it, hoping it’ll be the cheese at the end of the maze.

item.title: How Hugo Has Revolutionized My Personal Website: apsan.xyz
item.description:
As the creator of apsan.xyz, I’ve found Hugo to be an invaluable tool in developing and maintaining my personal website. This static site generator has not only simplified my workflow but also enhanced the overall performance and flexibility of my site. In this post, I’ll outline four key concepts that demonstrate how Hugo has been instrumental in improving apsan.xyz.

1. Lightning-Fast Performance

Hugo Speed Comparison

One of the most significant advantages of using Hugo for apsan.xyz is its blazing-fast performance. Hugo’s ability to generate static pages means that my website loads incredibly quickly, providing visitors with an seamless browsing experience. This speed boost is particularly noticeable when compared to dynamic content management systems.
